<ic>To appoint a General to the Wolves of War<br><br><i>Proposed by Sarvos, seconded by Karsk.</i></ic> 

===Overview===
* This motion was to choose a citizen to appoint as [[General]] to [[the_League|League]] [[army]] the [[The_League_military_concerns#The_Wolves_of_War|Wolves of War]].
* This motion was raised in the absence of a unanimous agreement among the four League [[Senator|senators]].

===Date===
* Autumn 379YE.

===Outcome===
* Gabriel Barossa was elected.
